summary: All three prior review issues are fixed correctly with comprehensive test coverage. Issue 1 (orphaned agents): agents with plan_phase_id not matching any wave are now routed to top_level_agents and rendered in the Pipeline agents box. Issue 2 (stem misalignment): both fan-out and fan-in now use bar_center for stem and junction placement. Issue 3 (tee overwrite): cross junction character used when bar_center coincides with an intermediate branch. Minor issues (plan_phase_names guard, variable naming) also addressed. All 183 DAG visualizer tests pass including 33 new dedicated review-fix tests.
